HealthCoreMD subscription-based telehealth programs provide “unlimited” doctor consultations on a fixed monthly rate for employers enrolling their workforce. 
There are no copays, no consultation fees or network access costs, and employers receive discounts based on the number of primary employee members enrolled. Plans may include dependent family members at no extra cost.

With 24/7/365 access to virtual doctor visits, employees are protected from unexpected expenses of doctor copays and urgent care clinic visits. As a member they will receive personalized service and real-human contact from the moment they reach out to our network of U.S. board certified doctors. All doctors and Care Coordinators are U.S. operate in the United States. Only licensed medical doctors conduct consultations, we do not contract with nurse practitioners to handle our consultations. Members access virtual care by phone, mobile app, or video consultations through their HIPAA-compliant “Member/Patient Portal”, fully functional in Spanish and English.

Quality Healthcare, Fast! On average, members receive a call back from the doctor within 8-12 minutes after scheduling a virtual consultation by phone, online or by mobile app. That's less than the drivetime to most urgent care clinics!

My Virtual Physician provides care across three disciplines: Primary/chronic care; Gynecology; and Endocrinology. My Virtual Physician provides the entire range of consults from simple acute visits to complex visits. My Virtual Physician offers patients in the virtual space the full range of services they would get in a comprehensive multi-specialty clinic in the brick and mortar world. 

If a patient needs a referral we will do all the paperwork. If a patient needs a medical exemption letter for work we will write it. If a patient needs a specialized imaging study, we will coordinate it. If a patient has social needs we will connect them to a community health worker. 

There is arguably no other national telehealth company in the US that provides comprehensive integrated care across multiple specialties the way that My Virtual Physician does. 

My Virtual Physician is blazing a trail in the telehealth world in the US.

Direct Med Clinic uses the Direct Primary Care (DPC) model to provide a solution to two big problems in health care today: cost and access. A person becomes a member of the clinic by paying a monthly membership fee. Then, anytime they come to the clinic for treatment it is free. The clinic treats all primary care and urgent care needs. By providing direct, transparent, and affordable access to primary care, many people with chronic medical problems that have previously gone untreated can now be taken care of which prevents end-organ damage when chronic conditions are not controlled.

On a large scale, employers who have struggled to provide health care benefits to employees can now do so without high deductibles that limit access. Small employers that have not been able to provide health care benefits to employees due to cost can now do so by directly contracting with Direct Med Clinic.

Our model is duplicatable and sustainable because it inherently provides value. We offer a spectrum of services from primary care to urgent care to occupational medicine. We are not bound by traditional reimbursement systems so, through our virtual care and HIPAA compliant app/tools, we can expand our access way beyond a single brick and mortar clinic which allows us to touch even more lives.

We at Direct Med Clinic are excited to be transforming healthcare, improving the quality of life and healing the bottom line of many companies by restoring the direct doctor-patient relationship with Direct Primary Care.

The views expressed in this social media account are those of the practice, not individual clinicians of the Direct Med Clinic team.
